gin.name: request_flow
gin.question: Trace Gin's successful HTTP request through the engine into execution of the middleware/handler chain. Return JSON with keys entry, dispatch, runner, each containing the repository-relative file:line of the relevant method declaration (one-based lines).

gin.name: missing_route
gin.question: For the same flow, when no route matches and no redirect or 405 applies, identify the function that executes the fallback chain, the Engine field supplying that chain, and the HTTP status. Return JSON {"function":"file:line","chain_field":"fieldName","status":number}.

gin.name: abort_semantics
gin.question: In that middleware chain, does Context.Abort immediately terminate the currently running handler? What numeric value does abortIndex evaluate to? Return JSON {"terminates_current_handler":boolean,"abort_index":number}.

django.name: query_evaluation
django.question: Trace normal synchronous iteration of a model QuerySet into database execution. Locate the QuerySet method that populates its result cache, the default model iterable's __iter__, and the SQLCompiler method that invokes cursor.execute. Return JSON {"cache_loader":"file:line","model_iterator":"file:line","executor":"file:line"} using repository-relative declaration lines. Exclude RawQuerySet and compiler subclasses.

django.name: compiler_branches
django.question: In the SQLCompiler executor from the previous answer, identify the method that produces SQL and parameters, and the connection method used when chunked_fetch is true. Return JSON {"sql_builder":"file:line","chunked_cursor_method":"methodName"} using the declaration line of the SQL-building method.

django.name: iteration_cache
django.question: Does a second ordinary iteration over the same fully evaluated, unchanged QuerySet rebuild its result cache? What is the value of GET_ITERATOR_CHUNK_SIZE? Return JSON {"rebuilds_cache":boolean,"default_chunk_size":number}.

excalidraw.name: canvas_entrypoints
excalidraw.question: Find the exported scene-rendering entry points for Excalidraw's element canvas and its interactive/UI canvas. Return JSON {"static_renderer":"file:line","interactive_renderer":"file:line"} with repository-relative declaration lines, not React component declarations.

excalidraw.name: render_scheduling
excalidraw.question: Follow the throttled execution branches of those two entry points. Locate the shared animation-frame throttling helper and the exported function that cancels both pending renders. Return JSON {"scheduler":"file:line","cancel":"file:line"} using declaration lines.

excalidraw.name: render_options
excalidraw.question: Do both scene-renderer throttles enable the trailing option? In the synchronous interactive-render branch, is the callback invoked before the result is returned? Return JSON {"both_trailing":boolean,"callback_before_return":boolean}.

vscode.name: rpc_dispatch
vscode.question: Trace VS Code's extension-host RPC incoming request from RPCProtocol._receiveRequest through its exception-to-promise wrapper to the method that selects the actor and calls method.apply. Return JSON {"receiver":"file:line","wrapper":"file:line","invoker":"file:line"} using repository-relative method declaration lines.

vscode.name: rpc_cancellation
vscode.question: In that protocol, locate the incoming cancellation handler and identify the numeric wire MessageType.Cancel value. Return JSON {"handler":"file:line","cancel_message_type":number} using the handler declaration line.

vscode.name: unknown_reply
vscode.question: When RPCProtocol receives a successful reply whose request ID is absent from _pendingRPCReplies, does it ignore it or throw? What is the numeric MessageType.ReplyOKJSON value? Return JSON {"behavior":"ignore or throw","json_reply_message_type":number}.
